intro.h2: Built for homeowners who were burned before
paragraphs: Bayshore Remodels offers kitchen remodeling in Largo, FL and across Pinellas, Hillsborough and Pasco counties from its office on Starkey Road. The company was set up for people who have been burned by a contractor: a deposit and then progress payments, a written scope broken out by trade, and changes approved in writing before extra work starts.

Prices are public. A small kitchen starts at $28,000, a full kitchen at $36,000 and a hall bath at $15,500. Bayshore also tells you when it is not the right fit. If you need only one trade, like an interior paint job, Justin will refer a sub he trusts.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Largo, FL and four more ways to update

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: You approve detailed renderings first, then your cabinets are delivered before demolition so the room never sits gutted. Most small kitchens run $28k to $36k and take 3 to 5 weeks on site; semi-custom to custom kitchens run $50k to $85k and up.

image.alt: Opened-up Largo kitchen remodel with white shaker cabinets, white quartz counters and wide-plank vinyl floors

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Hall baths from $15,500, tub-to-shower conversions from $23,000 and primary baths from $32,000. Fixtures and materials are on site before demolition, a 3D rendering comes first, and most bathrooms take 2 to 4 weeks once work starts.

image.alt: Belleair bathroom with walnut vanity, white quartz top, brass faucet and a blue tile walk-in shower with hex mosaic floor

items.name: Cabinet Refacing
items.blurb: New shaker, raised-panel, flat or beadboard doors and drawer fronts on the cabinet boxes you already have, with soft-close hinges and drawer slides standard. A medium kitchen usually lands at $10k to $12.5k, and most are done in 5 to 7 working days.

image.alt: Kitchen refaced with Delft blue shaker doors, white counters and a breakfast bar that looks out to the pool

items.name: Cabinet Refinishing
items.blurb: Doors and drawers go to a dedicated spray shop for a water-based commercial-grade coating while your kitchen is sealed off with dust barriers and air scrubbers. Smaller kitchens start at $5,000, and you keep a custom touch-up bottle for later.

image.alt: Refinished kitchen with an Indigo Baltic island, cream perimeter cabinets, butcher-block counter and blue patterned tile

items.name: Whole Home Remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchen, baths, floors, paint and built-ins on one contract and one schedule, with permits and inspections handled by the team. Full remodels start at $150,000. The flagship Belleair Beach renovation covered 1,950 square feet for $255,000.

image.alt: Whole-home remodel with open white kitchen, navy island, vaulted great room and new light vinyl plank floors

items.title: Materials before demolition
items.text: Cabinets, tile and fixtures are ordered and on the way before anything is torn out, so your kitchen never sits gutted while you wait for a delivery truck.

items.title: Your estimate is the price
items.text: Written estimates are free, broken out by trade and good for 30 days. If crews find rot or bad wiring, they stop, show you and price it in writing first.

items.title: Warranty in writing
items.text: One year on remodeling labor and workmanship, two years on interior and exterior painting, and a touch-up visit within 30 days of completion. Products carry the manufacturer warranty.

items.title: Specialists for every stage
items.text: Demolition, licensed plumbing, licensed electrical, drywall, tile, cabinet install, countertops and paint are each done by someone with at least 10 years in that one trade.

about.h2: Justin Eichler and a promise to his dad
about.text: Justin Eichler grew up in a small town as his dad's right-hand man, and the two of them talked about starting a remodeling business one day. After his father passed away, Justin focused on making that shared plan real. Bayshore Remodels has served Tampa Bay since 2021 and lists more than 200 completed projects. It is family owned and run on plain rules: tell the truth, price fairly and keep your word. The company also supports Rescue Dogs Dream, an all-volunteer dog rescue from Justin's hometown.

image.alt: Justin Eichler, owner of Bayshore Remodels in Largo, FL

steps.title: A quick call
steps.text: The office calls or texts within one business day to hear what you want to change, your timeline and a ballpark budget.

steps.title: Free consultation at home
steps.text: A free 30-minute visit with the owner to measure the space, check what is behind the work and talk through your options.

steps.title: Written estimate
steps.text: Broken out by trade and good for 30 days. Smaller jobs usually get one within a day; design projects take a few days.

steps.title: Design, select, order
steps.text: Every kitchen gets a 3D rendering, and bathrooms can too. All selections are made and materials confirmed before any work starts.

steps.title: Build and walkthrough
steps.text: Specialists handle each stage in order. Then you walk the room together, close out the punch list and get the warranty in writing.

service_area.h2: Where Bayshore works around Tampa Bay
service_area.text: The office is at 2101 Starkey Rd in Largo, in the middle of Pinellas County. Crews work across Pinellas, Hillsborough and Pasco, from St. Petersburg and Clearwater north to Wesley Chapel and Lutz, plus Belleair and the beach towns. Select Sarasota and Lakewood Ranch projects are taken on when the job makes sense. Not sure your street qualifies? Call and the office will tell you.

items.q: How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Largo?
items.a: Bayshore's published ranges: a small kitchen in the existing layout runs $28k to $36k, a full kitchen with new flooring $36k to $50k, and semi-custom to custom work $50k to $85k and up. Cabinets and counters are included; appliances, light fixtures and faucets are your selections. Your written estimate sets the actual price.

items.q: How long will my bathroom take?
items.a: Once work starts, a hall bathroom takes about 2 to 3 weeks and a primary bathroom 3 to 4 weeks. Permitted projects include inspection days in the schedule. Because the fixtures and tile are on site before demolition, the room is not left torn apart while you wait for parts.

items.q: Should I refinish, reface or remodel my cabinets?
items.a: Refinishing keeps your doors and changes the color, from $5,000. Refacing puts new doors and drawer fronts on the boxes you already have, from $7,000, and runs about $2,000 to $2,500 more than refinishing on a medium kitchen. If the layout has to change, a full remodel is the better fit.

items.q: What happens if you find a problem behind the wall?
items.a: Rot behind a dishwasher, two layers of old flooring or wiring that is not to code turn up on plenty of remodels. When the crew finds something, they stop, show you and price it in writing before any extra work happens. Every change is approved in writing first.

items.q: Can I supply my own materials?
items.a: Yes. Your own tile, vanity, faucets or fixtures are welcome, as long as they are on site before the trades need them. Bathroom starting prices cover the work, and most of what you pick out is budgeted separately as your selections, so you can see both numbers clearly.

final_cta.h2: Get a real number for your kitchen
final_cta.text: Call (813) 489-1552 or send the short form. The office replies within one business day to set up your free 30-minute consultation.
